description: This file defines the server-side code for the Dashboard page in an online examination system. It handles button click events to navigate or transfer the user to different pages such as user profile, leaderboard, start exam, and login.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: Code-behind class for the Dashboard web page, handling page load and button click events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently does nothing.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for 'Home' button click; currently does nothing.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the UserProfile page when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the Leaderboard page when the leaderboard button is clicked.

methods.name: sExamB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the StartExam page when the start exam button is clicked.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the LoginPage when the logout button is clicked.
